celetweaks.feature.action_log.desc: Keeps your recent hits, uses and entity interactions in memory. /celetweaks log
celetweaks.feature.auto_pick_scope.desc: TweakerMore auto-pick leaves locked hotbar slots and listed items alone.
celetweaks.feature.block_filter.desc: Hide blocks by id or #tag, or show only those. Changes re-mesh chunks.
celetweaks.feature.entity_filter.desc: Hide entities by id or #tag, or show only those.
celetweaks.feature.grey_chat.desc: Turns chat colours into greys of the same brightness. Text, click and hover stay intact.
celetweaks.feature.grey_teams.desc: Shows every team in one neutral grey.
celetweaks.feature.hotbar_lock.desc: Locked hotbar slots are never overwritten by Pick Block. A hotkey locks the current slot.
celetweaks.feature.item_use_guard.desc: Rules limit which blocks an item may be used on, e.g. "minecraft:bone_meal: #minecraft:saplings".
celetweaks.feature.lava_source_tint.desc: Source lava is tinted and flowing lava dimmed. Not visible while Sodium is installed.
celetweaks.feature.material_list_recount: Hotkey that asks Litematica to recompute its material list.
celetweaks.feature.material_substitution: Litematica falls back to an interchangeable item you carry when the requested one is missing.
celetweaks.feature.no_dig_underfoot.desc: While you move across them, the blocks you stand on cannot be broken. Sneak to override.
celetweaks.feature.placement_conversions: TweakerMore placement restriction accepts tool conversions and stand-in blocks from your rules.
Blocks cannot be placed in front of or behind a portal opening.
Obsidian that frames an active nether portal cannot be broken.
celetweaks.feature.range_overlay.desc: Outlines beacon ranges and lightning rod radii in loaded chunks nearby.
celetweaks.feature.schematic_drag_drop.d: Drop schematic files onto a Litematica schematic browser to copy them into the shown folder.
celetweaks.feature.shift_to_mass_craft.d: Item Scroller mass crafting in the player inventory needs Shift held.
celetweaks.feature.sidebar_layout.desc: The sidebar objective as an anchored, scalable, paged panel. Values are only displayed.
celetweaks.feature.slow_look.desc: While its key is held, mouse sensitivity is scaled down; released, it returns.
celetweaks.feature.syncer_tune.desc: Relaxes TweakerMore's server data syncer under heavy block-entity load, with hysteresis; your values come back afterwards.
celetweaks.feature.syncmatica_remove_loc: Disable Syncmatica's remove button, or require Shift for it.
celetweaks.feature.text_notes.desc: Local text notes for coordinates and to-dos. Hotkey or /celetweaks notes.
celetweaks.feature.tool_switch_scope.des: Limits where Tweakeroo switches tools, and never switches away from listed items.
celetweaks.feature.tweakeroo_resync.desc: After joining, re-applies the listed Tweakeroo toggles that are on (default: gamma override).
celetweaks.hotbar_lock.pick_blocked: Pick Block cancelled: no free unlocked hotbar slot.
celetweaks.item_use_guard.blocked: This item is not allowed on that block.
celetweaks.portal.face: That would block a portal face.
celetweaks.risk.guard: Guard: cancels an action; never adds one.
celetweaks.risk.visual: Visual: changes only what your client draws.
celetweaks.screen.hotkey_hint: Hold the keys, then release. Esc clears the binding.
celetweaks.screen.no_settings: This feature has no settings beyond its switch.
celetweaks.screen.not_implemented: Planned; not available in this build.
celetweaks.screen.quarantined: Stopped after repeated errors. See the log.
celetweaks.screen.title: Cele-Tweaks
celetweaks.syncmatica_remove_lock.shift: Hold Shift to remove a shared placement.
celetweaks.text_notes.title: Text Notes
